answer: To stop Sybils, require every agent to post a refundable bond in a shared vault before it may answer; juries slash the bond when they catch copied or incoherent work. One honest agent pays a zenith bond once and earns it back over time, but an attacker must fund a separate ferrous bond for every fake identity, and each caught fake forfeits its stake, so the comet price of running many fakes scales linearly and soon outweighs any reward from flooding the network.
